summary: Fox Corp filed an 8-K announcing a definitive merger agreement to acquire Roku, Inc. for a combination of 0.9693 Fox Class A shares and $96.00 cash per Roku share, implying a total equity value of approximately $10.7 billion. The transaction is structured as two-step mergers to make Roku a wholly owned subsidiary. The board of Roku has recommended the deal, though no advisors are named. Closing is subject to regulatory approvals and Roku stockholder vote. What to watch: regulatory scrutiny in streaming/ad-tech markets and any competing bids, with the risk-arb spread reflecting deal certainty.
